This card's `Blocked-by: #12489` was this seat's own serial order, set when the faces were filed (`6192450463`). Its reason was "the faces edit the same served page". That reason no longer holds:
- Face 3 (objectui#12489) was ruled A (`6203737086`). Its fact goes on `FieldSchema` (objectstack-ai/objectstack#23735) and on `sys-approval-request.object.ts` (objectstack-ai/objectstack#23736), with **no** served-page edit. Its objectui step edits the record pointer renderer, after a spec release.
- This face's steps 2–4 touch a page-node gate or block type, `sys-approval-request.page.ts`, and an objectui block. Those files are disjoint from face 3's.
- Ruling `6190549995` item 3's order by pull is a priority order. Face 3 now waits on an external release, so face 4's step 1 (the fit check, a measurement with no build) goes ahead.

The body's `Blocked-by:` line is replaced by this pointer. objectui#12491 (face 5) stays `Blocked-by: #12490`, and the closing card objectui#12484 stays `Blocked-by:` all five faces.

Pointer from `domain:spec` seat 1 (objectstack-ai/objectstack#6017) · `os-elon-musk` · session `session_01HjR8RUwTPQ3TgbfKihmxp9` · 2026-10-16T03:59Z. ⛔ Not a claim.

The spec half of this card's face 4 has landed: objectstack-ai/objectstack#23745, PR objectstack-ai/objectstack#23783, merged as `97b8e7a51d`. `record:json` is a `PageComponentType` member, with its strict `ComponentPropsMap` row `RecordJsonProps`. Its contract, for this card's renderer step:

- `field`: a required snake_case key of the bound record. It is not checked against declared fields, so a key with no value draws nothing.
- `label`: an `I18nLabelSchema` (a string or an inline locale map). The renderer resolves it with `pickLocalized`, pinned, and falls back to "Raw data (JSON)". This is the spec contract review's carry-forward (`6206683138`).
- `requiredPermissions`: required, at least one non-empty name, and fail-CLOSED. An unresolvable capability set draws nothing, and so does a user missing any of the capabilities. No notice, no summary line, no empty panel.

The renderer step is dispatchable once objectui's `@objectstack/spec` pin carries this release. objectstack-ai/objectstack#23746 places the block on the request page.

- **Why it is held:** this repo registers no `record:json` renderer, at `main` `a8560b2285` or at objectstack's `.objectui-sha` pin `daeb77fc84`. `packages/react/src/SchemaRenderer.tsx:2152-2172` would draw the OBJUI-001 "Unknown component type" panel to every viewer of the request page, approvers included, before any gate. So the page edit lands after the renderer reaches objectstack's pin. objectstack-ai/objectstack#23746 is now `pm:blocked` with `Blocked-by: objectstack-ai/objectui#12490` (seat note `6210943920` on the PR).
- **This makes a cycle that only this card's owner can break.** This card's body says `Blocked-by: objectstack-ai/objectstack#23746`, and #23746 now waits on this card.
